observations: The top assembly features a single large projector lens.
The bottom assembly features a dual-beam projector lens with a horizontal LED strip.
The units are resting on a tiled floor with a car body panel visible in the background.
A watermark 'FRANCON DE GREAT GLOBAL' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Original Toyota part, not China copy. No crack, all clips and brackets complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The internal projector lenses may be cracked or have internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing a clear close-up of the lens glass with a light source.

risks.risk: The LED strip may be broken or the bulbs may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the LED strip powered on and the bulbs functioning.

risks.risk: The assembly may be a generic aftermarket part rather than a genuine Toyota part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the plastic housing).

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the LED strip powered on and the bulbs working.
Close-up photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the plastic housing.
Photo of the rear of the assembly to check for a part number or serial code.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
